title: Apple : Greenlight Capital Exited Apple Stake -- CNBC | MarketScreener
text:
--Greennlight Capital has sold its remaining Apple Inc. (AAPL) shares, CNBC reported Friday, citing the firm's third-quarter letter to investors.
--The firm cited Apple's valuation and concerns about "Chinese retaliation against America's trade policies," CNBC reported.
https://www.cnbc.com/2018/10/05/david-einhorn-dumps-apple-on-fear-of-chinese-retaliation-against-americas-trade-policies.html
